;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2019 Iraqi protests]]
**At least five people are killed, and up to 30 wounded, when security forces fire live rounds at protestors trying to scale a [[barricade]] near Ahrar Bridge in [[Baghdad]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/iraq-forces-fire-live-rounds-protesters-baghdad-report-191104132950866.html (Al Jazeera)]
**The [[Government of Iraq|Iraqi government]] cuts off [[internet]] access in much of the country, including a total blackout in [[Baghdad]], amid continued civil unrest. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-protests-internet/internet-access-cut-off-in-much-of-iraq-netblocks-idUSKBN1XE2BK (Reuters)]
*[[LeBarón family massacre]]
**Gunmen kill 9 [[American Mexican]] [[Mormonism|Mormons]] in [[Sonora]], northern [[Mexico]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-50299562 (BBC News)] [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2019/11/05/mormon-family-killed-by-mexican-drug-cartel/4162955002/ (''USA Today'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-50310055 (BBC News)]
*[[Sinai insurgency]]
**[[Egyptian Armed Forces|Egypt military]] kill over 80 [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant – Sinai Province|Islamic State militants]] in central and North [[Sinai (peninsula)|Sinai]] over the month. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-egypt-security/egypt-forces-say-they-kill-83-militants-in-sinai-idUSKBN1XE14J (Reuters)]
*Nine crew members of a [[Norway|Norwegian]] ship were [[Kidnapping|kidnapped]] off the coast of [[Benin]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-50287013 (BBC News)]

;Disasters and accidents
*The [[Niagara Parks Commission]] says the wreckage of the [[Niagara Scow]], stuck in the rapids above [[Niagara Falls]] since 1918 before being moved downstream about 164 feet due to a strong storm, is being monitored as it moves closer to the edge of the falls, but that the scow could be stuck in its new position for "days or years." [https://news.sky.com/story/niagara-falls-barge-stuck-in-rapids-for-100-years-finally-moved-by-storm-11854350 (Sky News)] [https://www.ctvnews.ca/lifestyle/niagara-parks-staff-monitoring-barge-dislodged-in-storm-as-it-edges-closer-to-falls-1.4668928?fbclid=IwAR0MYZHeN1fkfNZYXolAgHC6xXbC1HTKOODCABzrqeVeFLTgXjsFCIpTYo4 (CTV News)]

;International relations
*[[Iran–United States relations]]
**On the 40th anniversary of the [[Iran hostage crisis]], [[Atomic Energy Organization of Iran]] chairman [[Ali Akbar Salehi]] announces [[Government of Iran|his government]] has doubled the amount of advanced [[Gas centrifuge|centrifuges]] limited by the [[Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action]], and are working on a prototype that is fifty times faster than those allowed. He blames the [[United States]]'s [[United States withdrawal from the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action|withdrawal from the agreement]] last year for these actions. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/iran-breaks-crumbling-nuclear-deal-191104110945872.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[United States withdrawal from the Paris Agreement]]
**The United States notifies the [[United Nations]] of its formal withdrawal from the [[Paris Agreement]]. [https://www.npr.org/2019/11/04/773474657/u-s-formally-begins-to-leave-the-paris-climate-agreement (NPR)]
*[[Japan–South Korea relations]]
**South Korean President [[Moon Jae-in]] hold a 11-minute conversation with Japanese Prime Minister [[Shinzō Abe]] at ASEAN summit in [[Bangkok]]. [http://www.hani.co.kr/arti/english_edition/e_international/915886.html (''The Hankyoreh'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Tax returns of Donald Trump]]
**The [[United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit|U.S. Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit]] rules that [[Mazars]], a global audit, accounting and consulting group, must turn over eight years of [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s [[tax return|tax returns]] in its possession to [[New York County District Attorney]] [[Cyrus Vance Jr.]] [https://www.forbes.com/sites/lisettevoytko/2019/11/04/trump-loses-appeal-ordered-to-hand-over-tax-returns/?fbclid=IwAR0Kp0B4qRZgxb05l_4a3wKWelonXpnsLTE802Wq6qQLDENm8BNDo2fsp24#143695434e30 (''Forbes'')]
*[[Impeachment inquiry into Donald Trump]]
**The U.S. [[United States House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence|House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence]], the [[United States House Committee on Oversight and Reform|House Committee on Oversight and Reform]] and the [[United States House Committee on Foreign Affairs|House Committee on Foreign Affairs]] release the transcripts of the first two closed-door depositions in the [[impeachment inquiry into Donald Trump|impeachment inquiry]] into [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]]. The testimonies are that of former [[United States Ambassador to Ukraine|Ambassador to Ukraine]] [[Marie Yovanovitch]] and former [[United States Ambassador to Brazil|Ambassador to Brazil]] [[Michael McKinley]]. Yovanovitch said she felt threatened by President Trump, while McKinley said that he resigned from his position because he was concerned about "the engagement of our missions to procure negative political information for domestic purposes," something he says he had never observed the [[United States State Department|State Department]] try to take part in throughout his career, with the exception of the Trump administration. [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/11/04/politics/house-intelligence-committee-deposition/index.html (CNN)]
**[[United States House of Representatives|U.S. House]] [[Republican Party (United States)|Republicans]] are reportedly having "active and serious" discussions about assigning [[Ohio]] Representative [[Jim Jordan (American politician)|Jim Jordan]] to the [[United States House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence|House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence]] so that the [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican Party]] can more effectively challenge the [[impeachment inquiry into Donald Trump|impeachment inquiry]] into [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]]. [https://www.mediaite.com/news/house-republicans-reportedly-consider-temporarily-assigning-jim-jordan-to-intelligence-committee-to-fight-impeachment/?fbclid=IwAR16WSz9hdTNvW3OXsSB6BpKOGzaiZ7PmbPe561ChRvSxLWLe46drw7dQwo (Mediaite)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Speaker of the British House of Commons election]]
**[[Member of Parliament (United Kingdom)|Members]] of the [[House of Commons of the United Kingdom|UK House of Commons]] vote to elect a new [[Speaker of the House of Commons (United Kingdom)|Speaker of the House]], replacing the retiring [[John Bercow]]. The [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour Party]]'s [[Lindsay Hoyle|Sir Lindsay Hoyle]] defeats [[Chris Bryant]] in the fourth and final ballot. [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/live/2019/nov/04/general-election-news-latest-health-chief-urge-parties-not-to-use-nhs-as-political-weapon-live-news?page=with:block-5dc0517a8f0878b83f8e96f3 (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Politics of Romania]]
**The [[Parliament of Romania|Romanian Parliament]] elects [[Ludovic Orban]] as [[Prime Minister of Romania|Prime Minister]] after [[Viorica Dăncilă]] was ousted on 10 October by a [[vote of no-confidence]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/romanian-cabinet-wins-parliamentary-confidence-vote-66740653 (ABC News)]

;Science and technology
*[[Voyager program]]
**[[NASA]] says it has received the first message from [[interstellar space]] from its [[Voyager 2|''Voyager'' 2]] spacecraft. [https://www.theguardian.com/science/2019/nov/04/nasa-voyager-2-sends-back-first-signal-from-interstellar-space (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.jpl.nasa.gov/news/news.php?feature=7530 (Jet Propulsion Laboratory)]

;Sports
*[[Hulman & Company]], owners of the [[Indianapolis Motor Speedway]] and [[IndyCar|INDYCAR, LLC]] (including the [[IndyCar Series]]), announces its sale to Penske Entertainment Corp., a subsidiary of [[Penske Corporation]], parent company of [[Team Penske]]. The transaction is expected to close in January, pending regulator approval and ends 74 years of Hulman-George family ownership of the historic [[race track]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/roger-penske-buys-indianapolis-motor-speedway-and-indycar/2019/11/04/8ad87982-ff06-11e9-8341-cc3dce52e7de_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
